reduction_patterns.veto: Do not promote update-order/non-commutativity claims unless a formal object survives those same-information theories.
A time-varying best checkpoint/half-life is not a new problem by itself.
Different validation/test/robustness rankings are not novel without a non-reducible decision object.
Versioned agent-resource operator closure is not novel when the protocol already defines the state/operator algebra.
Naming a self-evolution stream Lyapunov exponent is domain transfer unless the dynamics add a new structural constraint.
An information ceiling for self-generated supervision is already occupied unless a distinct information source/constraint changes the theorem.
Sparse validation/filtering tradeoffs are not a new scientific object.
Shared evaluator-policy ancestry is not new unless same-information causal/statistical dependence models cannot express the prediction.
Pre/post scaffold semantics comparability is domain transfer when generalized inter-MDP equivalence solves the same question.
Persistent update necessity is already an explicit harness/skill evaluation question; require a new structural prediction, not another comparison.
NO-AUTHORITY evidence transitions are not novel if typed credibility partitions or conditional independence reproduce the same belief update.
A harness/skill that is valid but not activated or faithfully followed by a target model is not a new object unless it escapes cross-model prompt/artifact compatibility under the same information.
Retrieved experience that fails to change behavior is already a utilization/uptake bottleneck; require a new causal object beyond retrieval and instruction-following decomposition.

Past actions affecting future behavior through the current world state are not evidence of internal memory; this distinction is mature state/mediation theory unless a new embodied-only prediction survives.
Visual details that cannot be compressed into text are not a new self-evolution problem when multimodal skills already preserve state cards/keyframes and rate-distortion captures information loss.

generator_revision.old_failure: Free-form generators produced mathematically named versions of mature problems and malformed long JSON; formatting repair was treated as advisory-only and never as scientific evidence.
generator_revision.new_rule: Start from a documented contradiction between recent primary-source results; name the two strongest mature theories first; a candidate is generated only if an exact prediction remains that both theories cannot express under the same information.

next_action: Continue contradiction-first literature discovery in less-saturated subdomains; do not create methods, experiments, P0 entries, or GPU work until a problem survives the mature-theory veto.
